name: com.daymaker/daymaker
title: Daymaker
description: Research leads, pick gifts they would love and send them, as you, in your Daymaker workspace.

environmentVariables.name: DAYMAKER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Daymaker API key (dmk_live_...), made in Daymaker under Settings, API and MCP. It acts as the person who made it.

environmentVariables.name: DAYMAKER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to offer only the tools that change nothing: reads and price checks.

environmentVariables.name: DAYMAKER_MCP_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated scopes (read, work, send) to offer only the tools your key reaches.
